claims: Invincible Season 4 premieres on Prime Video on Wednesday, March 18, 2026, at 3 a.m. ET / 12 a.m. PT.
The premiere of Invincible Season 4 includes the first three episodes.
The first three episodes of Invincible Season 4 will be released simultaneously worldwide.
Invincible Season 4 premieres in the UK at 7 a.m. GMT.
Invincible Season 4 premieres in India at 12:30 p.m. IST.
Invincible Season 4 premieres in Singapore at 3 p.m. SGT.
Invincible Season 4 premieres in Australia at 6 p.m. AEDT.
The premiere episodes of Invincible Season 4 are titled "Making the World a Better Place," "I'll Give You the Grand Tour," and "I Gotta Get Some Air".
